name: Desired State Manifest — ETag & Content-Type Correctness
description: Per docs.margo.org/specification/margo-management-interface/desired-state: MI-004/MI-027 (ETag MUST be sha256:<64 lowercase hex>), MI-006/MI-007 (200 OK manifest response MUST carry Content-Type application/vnd.margo.manifest.v1+json), MI-026 (first manifest for a client MUST use manifestVersion 1), MI-030 (matching If-None-Match MUST return 304 with an empty body). MIAF transport: caller identity comes from the mTLS client SVID (mtls:true) — there is no onboarding call and no {clientId} path segment (see CONFORMANCE_FLOWS_AND_MIAF_MIGRATION.md Part 5.4/6). Run against base URL <wfm-host>:<sbi-port>/v1alpha2/margo with an SVID loaded at <cert-dir>/svid-{cert,key}.pem and the WFM's trust bundle at <cert-dir>/svid-ca.pem.
